notes: The 5.89.1 metadata refresh grew plugin.json's description to 644 characters and the plugin upload failed validation: "description must be at most 500 characters" — a description the installer refuses is a release nobody can take. Trimmed to 482 without losing a pillar, synced to marketplace.json, and the 500-character bound is now asserted in version.test.js beside the version-agreement guards, so an over-long description fails the battery instead of the upload.
